units.source_text: 姑娘上身微倾，全神贯注地俯视着躺在面前的男人。

en.t: The girl leaned forward slightly and gazed intently down at the man lying before her.

units.source_text: 她那小心翼翼的动作，一眨也不眨的严肃目光，都表现出她的真挚感情。

en.t: Her careful movements and her serious, unblinking gaze both revealed her sincere feelings.

units.source_text: 男人头靠窗边躺着，把弯着的腿搁在姑娘身边。

en.t: The man lay with his head by the window, resting his bent legs beside the girl.
This was a third class carriage.

units.source_text: 他们的座位不是在岛村的正对面，而是在斜对面。

en.t: Their seats were not directly opposite Shimamura, but diagonally across from him.

units.source_text: 所以在窗玻璃上只映出侧身躺着的那个男人的半边脸。

en.t: So the window glass reflected only half of the face of the man lying on his side.
